last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 43
last_episode_to_air.overview: JIM and COCO finally decide to disclose their relationship to JIM’s brother.  ROY cannot go further in his relationship with HEATHER, with which he is so frustrated.  ROY is summoned to see ADRIAN all of a sudden.  ADRIAN infers from a phone conversation that HEATHER may have got another boyfriend, leaving him to wonder if it is possible to probe for more information from ROY who is living in the same building as HEATHER.  ROY finally plucks up the courage to reveal the truth to ADRIAN, who turns out to be immensely enraged by the news.  SAM is to assess JAYDEN and HOLIDAY as the Authorized Examiner of CAD.  The three of them remain incredibly silent all through the flight, making the atmosphere a little tense.  The aircraft shakes violently all of a sudden.  COCO looks through the window and is shocked to see that the engine has caught fire.  Immediately she goes to inform JAYDEN…

name: Triumph in the Skies
overview: Triumph in the Skies is about the daily lives of the staff,  working under Solar Airways (a fictional airline based on Hong Kong's Cathay Pacific).  It has been compared to the now-cancelled NBC series LAX. It sparked an interest in aviation when first aired amongst Hong Kong viewers, as well as an interest in a small doll named "Triangel" featured early on in the series.

seasons.name: Triumph in the Skies
seasons.overview:
Triumph in the Skies is about the daily lives of the staff of the fictional airline Solar Airways. It revolves around the friendship of Samuel Tong and Vincent Ling, childhood friends who became pilots for Solar Airways, balancing their friendship, professional life, and their goals to become Hong Kong's first ethnic Chinese captain. Samuel and Vincent are then thrust into a love triangle relationship with Belle, an air stewardess with Solar.

After many misunderstandings and lost opportunities, the love triangle came to an end. Vincent and Belle became married, while Samuel became acquainted with Zoe, a sick passenger who came to idolize him.  All the while, Solar begins cadet recruitment. Samuel Tong's long lost younger brother Issac enters it to prove to Samuel, that he can make it as a cadet. There he meets Chris, Donald, Roy, and Zita and they subsequently became close friends. Like his brother, Issac is also thrust into a love triangle with Zita and Donald.

seasons.name: Triumph in the Skies II
seasons.overview: Triumph in the Skies II takes place a few years after airline pilot captain Sam (Francis Ng) marries Zoe (Myolie Wu), a passenger service agent who was born with a severe heart condition. When Zoe dies, the introverted and mournful Sam resigns his position as pilot captain and spends a long vacation in England. There, he meets the heartbroken student pilot Holly (Fala Chen), who convinces him to return to Hong Kong to join Skylette Airlines.
